sixtyfive_problems.note: Full re-audit. 65 confirmed unique problems across Notion + all archives.

breakthroughs.insight: 3Sum — a+b+c=0 rewrites to a+b=-c. Fix c, 2Sum the rest with two pointers. 3-level duplicate handling: (1) skip fixed num, (2) advance pointers after triplet, (3) skip adjacent dupes with two separate while loops, guard FIRST.
deque([root]) — deque takes an iterable. TreeNode is not iterable. [root] is the list wrapper that makes a single node passable.
breakthroughs.problem: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal (deque question)

breakthroughs.insight: Diameter of Binary Tree — two separate things at each node: return height (for parent's calculation), update max_diameter (side effect via nonlocal). Never mix them.
Monotonic Stack — store INDEX not tuple. Update the POPPED element's answer.
BFS level separation — snapshot len(queue) BEFORE the inner loop, not during.
Multi-source BFS — start BFS from ALL '0' cells simultaneously for 01 Matrix.
